body:
### Summary

## Problem Statement

I am trying to add a depdency from a private Git repo (not on Github), where the username is not `git`:

```
$ uv add 'some_package@git+ssh://mygituser@my-gitserver/myorg/some-package.git'
```

The resulting source URL in pyprojects.toml looks like this:

```
some-package = { git = "ssh://my-gitserver/myorg/some-package.git" }
```

As you can see, the username (`mygituser`) has just been dropped, so keeping the dependency uptodate will not work.

## Expected behaviour

The resulting URL should look like this:

```
some-package = { git = "ssh://mygituser@my-gitserver/myorg/some-package.git" }
```

### Platform

Debian 13.7

### Version

0.12.23

### Python version

Python 3.13.5
title: Adding Private Git Repo With SSH Drops Username
